title: A plain assignment loses to the command line
objective: Make the build mode a default that any value passed on the command line can replace, while a bare make still uses it.
hint: Values given on the command line win over every ordinary assignment in the Makefile. Drop the override keyword and the command line takes over again.

steps.description: a bare make uses the Makefile's value
steps.stdout:
echo mode is debug
mode is debug

echo mode is release
mode is release

steps.description: any command line value wins, not just one particular one
